title: Akiyama Mizuki — For A Jolly Test Of Courage!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: For A Jolly Test Of Courage!（2★）

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I've finished making those fixes to the music video! I'm gonna document everything now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was fast. I only just sent over those edit suggestions to you.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's because Enanan's illustrations meshed so well with your song this time around, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Putting this video together was a cinch because I knew exactly what I needed to do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, that should be everything...
I'll post the doc over now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. I'll take a look at it a little later.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, now that I've basically finished everything I needed to do, can I work on something else after I take a quick break? I've been meaning to make more progress on it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heh heh heh... The designs for a few costumes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Correct♪ After you all told me the concept for it, I haven't been able to stop coming up with all these great ideas! I had to get my designs on paper right away!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. I'm sure they're going to turn out very well if you're working on them, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Test of courage? Costumes...?
Am I the only one not following here?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, right. We haven't told you yet, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki and Emu are volunteering to pull weeds as part of their work as class reps.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <One thing led to another, and they're gonna do a test of courage at the shrine!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, you skipped way too many steps just now! How do you go from pulling weeds to doing a test of courage?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Really?
I figured that you'd know us well enough to fill in the blanks yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Otori first suggested that you do a test of courage, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, because we were having so much trouble getting people to just come pull weeds with us.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She wanted to make things more fun for everyone, so she suggested that we use a part of the shrine where we'd be pulling weeds to do a test of courage.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hmm... More fun, huh...?
Yeah, that does sound like something Emu would suggest.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Not only that, she wants to make it so people who don't really like being scared can also have fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Actually, Enanan, why don't you come join us?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Honami and Shizuku are also gonna be there! You'd be surrounded by friends, so I have a feeling that you'd really enjoy it, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But pulling weeds...
That means dealing with bugs and getting my hands all dirty, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You're gonna make Emu cry.
Don't you know how much time and effort she's been putting into this event?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I get that...
But we're talking about two separate issues here.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, I might be willing to try this test of courage if it really isn't meant to be all that scary.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Then, you're in the same boat as Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Hold on a second, Amia...
You're only gonna be there for the test of courage? So, what was all of that just now?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, cut me some slack! I was gonna be there to pull weeds with everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I couldn't get anyone to cover for me at work... So, I have to settle for only being there for the test of courage.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I still have time to find someone, so I'm gonna keep trying!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, fine.
Anyway, when is this event happening?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Next weekend...
Oh, I have art class, so I don't think I'll be able to make it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Darn it. That's too bad.
I'm guessing that also goes for the test of courage?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, because the thing we'll be working on is probably gonna be really time-consuming. I won't be out until pretty late, and I'll be too tired for anything like a test of courage.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, I unfortunately won't be able to go.
But say hi to everyone for me, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, I'm gonna put together some really amazing costumes and put on a fun performance so that everyone goes home happy!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Let's do our best to make that happen, Yuki!>
